description: This file defines the SnapshotRenderer class used for rendering HTML snapshots, including functions for URL rewriting, DOM traversal, and canvas handling within the context of Playwright's trace viewer. It manages rendering of DOM nodes, resource fetching, and visual overlays for testing purposes.

classes.name: SnapshotRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering HTML snapshots, managing cache, resources, and generating HTML content with overlays and resource links.

methods.name: viewport
methods.description: Returns the viewport size of the current snapshot.

methods.name: closestScreenshot
methods.description: Finds and returns the SHA1 of the closest screenshot frame based on wall time or timestamp.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the HTML representation of the snapshot, including DOM traversal, resource embedding, and overlays.

methods.name: resourceByUrl
methods.description: Retrieves resource snapshot matching a URL and method, considering frame and cache.
